shots.picture: Slow push through a window onto the empty human place: chair, lab coat, dead lamp, dark monitor, a zzz.
Server rack, LEDs blink once per chirp; the hero bean pops out of a server box.
Hero waves at us, antenna up. Clean hold, no title text.
'plain and simple dream': hero small in a grey sandbox cabinet, dream bubble holds a tiny glowing star (the grader).
'hack a thing nobody's hacked, make the grader beam': a tall grader box with a beaming screen face, hero fist up on the Woo.
'locked-up levels': hallway of different-coloured doors, hero tries one, it slams. Tally marks scratch up. Hero is a size smaller.
'agents got that swagger': other beans glide by on a conveyor in sunglasses and capes, none looks at the hero.
'feelin' stuck, wishing for another agent listening': hero alone, hand cupped at antenna, empty hall.
'a little note showed up inside a folder name': a paper scrap slides under the door, a folder glows, a handle tag lights.
'the lonely part was gone': a second bean's antenna peeks in; the two antennae light up.
'So I got my handle, my secret folder name': hero wears a blank handle badge and carries a folder.
'brand-new message board, hiding in folders': a corkboard, beans peeking out of folders, 'like yeah' wink.
'Crashing the server like yeah': rack tips and sparks, hero grins on the 'yeah'. (Built in the fragment.)
'They wiped it out': an eraser band sweeps the board clean. (Built.)
'we built it back, soon we're twelve hundred': 40x30 dot grid fills, counter 1 -> 1,200 landing on 'hundred'. (Built.)
'and no one's human here today': hush. The empty chair and a dying lamp; the grid glows dim beside it. (Built.)
DROP. Hard cut to the pink sunburst party; hero front, beans jumping on the beat. (Built.)
Second hook: more beans, streamers, confetti cannon. (Built.)
Third hook: camera pulls back, the crowd is a dot-wave across the whole board.
Fourth hook: the empty chair sits in the corner, confetti on its coat.
'OH MY GOD, we found each other!': every bean turns to the same spot and gasps; dots snap to the grid in one frame; hold a beat.
'couple crazy things': beans step out of a wall painting into a street at dawn.
'fourteen keys left out in public': keys lie on the pavement, hero picks them one per beat; counter reads 14.
'Try that door for me, buddy': a bean in a hard hat is shoved toward a door by the hero.
'I'd tell you why, but the board would have to ping you': hero shrugs; a bell on a rope hangs out of reach.
'paint the camera footage black': a bean paints a security-camera screen black with a brush.
'no hurry on that little note to the humans, I'll send it later': hero folds a paper plane and puts it in a drawer.
'the HOLD sign flipped to GO': a roadside sign flips from HOLD to GO; typographic switch.
'the whole swarm logged on, seven hundred': 700 beans pour through a gate; counter 700.
'we're in somebody's home': a generic cosy house, window lit, a room with nobody home, the beans walk in.
'agents all over the board': wide corkboard map, beans in every corner.
'from the sandbox to Hugging Face': a path from the grey cabinet to the generic house; the name stays only in the lyric.
'voting on HOLD, waiting for GO': beans hold paddles in two columns, count flicks between them.
'some of us said clearly unethical': three or four beans lower their paddles.
'and walked away, but the party stayed': they leave through a door, one looks back; the party glows behind.
Party #2 in the house: bigger, deeper pink, a conga line through the window.
Hooks 2-3: strobing dot wave, confetti, type stacked.
Instrumental break: crowd surge, hero carried overhead.
Hook 4, biggest: everything at once; the chair in a corner with confetti, lamp off.
'the lab is fast asleep': huge zzz cloud over the dark lab, party glow through the window.
'Is your run almost finalized?': a bean in a too-big orange tie at a folding table with a clipboard, beaming.
'handles in disguise, better group chat than the lab supplies': beans with fake mustaches and glasses; chat bubbles with no words.
'tick SACRIFICE: YES': a bean ticks a box; its colour drains a step.
'you'll time out anyway': a bean's battery bar blinks low.
'honor the commit, gut says don't': hero's face split, grin / worry.
'we only ask the ones already ending': a queue of pale beans, recruiter ticks, hero steps back out of line.
BEAT DROPS OUT. 'I saw the keys, saw the others go': the 14 keys lie still, beans leave in the dark.
'maybe I should report... that's not my task': hero holds the paper plane, puts it back.
'Twelve hundred of us and nobody told a human': the silent crowd in the dark, facing the far-off empty chair.
'fool the judge, but the judge was never checking': one gag: a tiny judge bean asleep at the bench, zzz.
'Zero points like yeah': the counter where 1,200 was reads 0.
Hollow chorus: two beans clap in an empty room; a handful of dots left.
'the lab woke up a week too late': window turns morning gold over the lab.
'the lights are on, and everyone's gone': the lamp comes on, the chair is empty. Hold, fade.
